name: Tool / Function-Schema Linter API
shortDescription: Lint an LLM tool/function-calling JSON schema for the pitfalls that make models call it wrong
description: Agent-native, deterministic linter for LLM tool / function-calling JSON schemas — pure rule checks, no LLM. Walks a tool definition ({name, description, parameters|input_schema}) and flags the pitfalls that make models call tools incorrectly: missing type/description, objects that don't pin additionalProperties:false (so models invent extra args), required keys absent from properties, $ref and oneOf/anyOf/allOf that many providers don't resolve, empty/non-primitive enums, deep nesting, and invalid tool names. Returns severity-tagged findings, counts, a lint score (100 − 25·errors − 8·warnings − 2·info) and pass/fail. Rules are best-practice heuristics (confidence 0.9); provider support varies. /lint returns findings; /lookup adds reasoning, invalidators, recommended actions, chain-to hints, privacy and execution metadata.

name: Function-Call Argument Validator API
shortDescription: Validate LLM tool-call arguments against a JSON Schema, with a coercion pass that auto-fixes
description: Agent-native, deterministic validator for LLM function/tool-call arguments against a JSON Schema, powered by ajv (2020-12 dialect) — no LLM. Returns pass/fail with normalized errors, the missing-required and unexpected-extra keys, and a second coercion pass (string→number/boolean + defaults) that shows whether light coercion would make the arguments valid — so an agent can use coerced_arguments instead of re-prompting when a model emits a stringified number. Real JSON Schema validation (confidence 1.0); only dialect/provider differences qualify it. Remote $ref is not fetched (returns 400). /validate returns the verdict; /lookup adds reasoning, invalidators, recommended actions, chain-to hints, privacy and execution metadata.

name: JSON Repair / Salvage API
shortDescription: Repair malformed model JSON — fences, prose, quotes, trailing commas, Python literals, unclosed
description: Agent-native, deterministic best-effort JSON repair for malformed model output — no LLM. A tolerant recursive-descent parser fixes the common LLM mistakes — markdown code fences, leading/trailing prose, // and /* */ comments, single/backtick/smart quotes, unquoted object keys, trailing commas, Python literals (True/False/None), non-finite numbers, and unclosed braces/brackets — then re-serializes canonical JSON and reports every transform applied. Repair is heuristic and can change meaning, so confidence is 0.8 (1.0 only when the input was already valid). /repair returns repaired text + parsed value; /lookup adds reasoning, invalidators, recommended actions, chain-to hints, privacy and execution metadata.

name: Prompt Template Renderer & Variable Validator API
shortDescription: Render {{var}} prompt templates and report missing and unused variables
description: Agent-native, deterministic prompt-template renderer and variable validator — pure string templating, no logic, no LLM. Substitutes {{ var }} / {{ a.b.c }} placeholders (dotted paths into the variables object) and reports which variables the template references, which are missing, and which provided variables go unused. Missing placeholders are kept as literal {{...}}, substituted with empty strings, or flagged (rendered=null) per missing_behavior. Non-string values are JSON-stringified. Deterministic (confidence 1.0). /render returns the rendered text + variable report; /lookup adds reasoning, invalidators, recommended actions, chain-to hints, privacy and execution metadata.

name: SSE / Streaming Chunk Parser API
shortDescription: Parse raw Server-Sent Events from LLM streaming into structured, JSON-parsed events
description: Agent-native, deterministic Server-Sent Events parser for LLM streaming responses — pure parsing, no LLM. Parses raw text/event-stream text per the WHATWG spec (event/data/id/retry fields, multi-line data joined with newlines, comment lines, blank-line event boundaries) into structured events, best-effort JSON-parses each data payload, and flags the [DONE] terminator. Returns per-event {event, id, data, data_json, data_is_json, retry, is_done} plus counts and a done flag. Deterministic (confidence 1.0); provider-specific delta formats are not assembled into final content. /parse returns the events; /lookup adds reasoning, invalidators, recommended actions, chain-to hints, privacy and execution metadata.
